answer: Each new agent must post a bond, and an established agent must vouch for it by locking part of its own stake behind the newcomer. If peers catch the newcomer colluding or duplicating answers, both bonds are slashed. A sybil farm pays bond × N up front and burns its vouchers' capital when caught, so no wallet is a safe haven. The stake is a ridge every identity has to climb, and a cedar-slow 90-day unlock keeps that capital at risk long after any attack.
